admission: No implementation-time census/regression. Future science requires separately approved committed trial plan and real launch.json/environment.json from unchanged tools/experiment_execution.py. Fixtures fixed public only.
driver_termination: A process cannot observe its own eventual exit. process.json.gz explicitly records returncode:null and termination:pending_outer_supervisor_exit, with computation_status. Actual child returncodes/signals/PIDs are observed; unchanged native execution-receipt.json owns actual driver and checker termination identities.

finite_bounds.gzip_upper_rule: Conservative DEFLATE/gzip engineering bound: at most 2*uncompressed_bytes+1024 per deterministic gzip member, without assuming compression ratio; actual gzip byte lengths/seals recorded. States have one empty initial member plus 48 curve members, hence <=841407488 compressed bytes. Fixed census.stdout.log has 48 bounded reference records (<65536 bytes), not a second state stream.
finite_bounds.machine_costs: Elapsed and process-lifetime ru_maxrss reported as observed with wall_valid=false. Per-child RSS, machine instruction weights and old attack/native primitive counters unknown.
finite_bounds.native_memory_derivation: vector<int> labels plus vector<uint32_t> generation marks: 8*r on observed 32-bit int platform; two at most L unsigned vectors and bounded iostream state. Record binary/platform; reject unqualified portability inference.
finite_bounds.native_stdout_storage: Retained once in states.jsonl.gz, with exact byte/hash references in small census.stdout.log.
finite_bounds.python_representation: Only one curve orbit, labels and compact records are live. <=r*(6*(list_header+14*pointer+14*max_cell_int_size)+outer_list+6*max_state_int_size) for compact rows, plus orbit/seen/labels and process provenance. At freeze on CPython, measure object sizes in checks; actual RSS recorded separately, never inferred from payload. Supervisor enforces 4096MiB.
finite_bounds.source_capture_bound: Per invocation full source closure bytes base64 before and after plus input bytes base64; process.json contains 1 compiler invocation and 48 native invocations for full census. Its exact bound is determined by frozen source byte lengths and actual compiled binary size, without compression assumptions.
finite_bounds.work_bound: For each curve exactly r orbit labels, r-1 states, six cap tests/state; uncapped words 2^e*sum_{j<=t}C(L-e,j), <=616/cell (no cap beyond fixed erasures). Every legal word pays two diagnostic equation certifications, zero included.

fixed_controls: Ten unittest groups: exhaustive independent dyadic-scalar filtering on Z17/Z29; real F23 predicate, genuine/negated/allundefined, erasure/cap/zero/list/conversion and both checks; native14-field output schema; exact A/A canonical serialization; malformed/YAML/duplicate/member/hash/seal/source/partial/wrongcurve/missingstate/zero mutations; gzip stored forms and cached native identity pointer; actual launch-context driver -> unchanged complete_manifest early unchanged -> actual checker, plus native fact contradictions; actual native invalid-input/SIGTERM and actual source-mismatch partial exports. No scientific48 or retained-regression execution.
input_rule: Bind actual Git bytes of committed small inventories/storage metadata, never full hydrated-member SHA as Git pointer SHA. verify_payloads fully verifies member SHA256 and size before any scientific read, plus all storage metadata. Census reads original public cohort and setups; regression additionally original singles/traces/intents/cells. No derived supervisor views.
native_stdin: ASCII r L curve_index followed by exactly r signed label integers (-1,0,1), EOF; source-bound diagnostic label table. No optional target/arm knobs.
partial_export: Any caught implementation/source/process failure retains actual source before/after, process data with unknown driver exit pending supervisor, partial.json, incomplete export listing present/missing members, and raw-result complete:false. No missing-data density or q=0 is emitted. Uncatchable termination leaves missing required artifacts and fails closed.
plan_input_map: Actual frozen protocol path supplied in trial plan exact_density.protocol, full-file SHA input-bound separately from canonical freeze hash.
plan_source_map: Hash all seven actual committed harness files plus unchanged tools/artifact_store.py. source-manifest hashes other six and existing runtime source only; no cycle. Exact runtime-reader bytes/hash captured with each invocation. Tests additionally load unchanged native supervisor/checker helpers; Python executable/runtime/compiler versions recorded.
preparation_schema: One record per curve: exact model/base/primary, setup fields/reason, compact labels (u/0/1), full orbit and answer-stream hashes, identity/distinct/order/equation certification, actual diagnostic counters. Labels and orbit are paid diagnostic preparation; never candidate advice or an attack.
provenance: Exact full sourcebytes/base64 and hashes immediately before/after every scientific child invocation; binary bytes/hash for every native invocation; compiler executable hash/version/flags, stdin bytes/hash, argv, selected noncredential environment, PID, actual RC/signal, times, preserved original stdout/stderr. On exceptions write partial/source/process artifacts; missing data stays missing. Supervisor outer termination receipt supplies actual driver exit identity.
regression: Deferred all216 setups/345600 singles/36864 physical original traces plus every retained incremental counterpart/73728 cells/3068802 words; fresh public predicate/trace/list/conversion/both-equation checks. One raw row at a time with trace/intent byte-offset indices. Stop on first mismatch preserving original input row via immutable payload and named id; no old producer execution.

state_schema.native_stdout: C++ emits the exact canonical seven-field state row including curve_index. Driver stores those stdout bytes once, unchanged inside concatenated deterministic gzip members in states.jsonl.gz. census.stdout.log contains per-invocation compressed byte offsets, uncompressed byte/line counts and SHA256 references; no duplicate native full stdout.
state_schema.strict_override: t0.e0 uses original UNDEFINED on capped erasures; no rows discarded

stored_forms: Seven bulk logical files are explicitly gzip-encoded before native supervisor compaction: states.jsonl.gz, preparations.jsonl.gz, summary.json.gz, process.json.gz, regression.json.gz, provenance.before.json.gz, provenance.after.json.gz. The native compactor sees gzip magic and treats their content as identity. Read raw logical bytes via unchanged artifact_store.open_artifact, then decode declared gzip exactly once. Full declared logical compressed SHA256/size and decompressed curve-stream SHA remain separately bound. Tests include local gzip stored forms and precompressed identity pointer/cache forms without network.
summary: 48*6 rows, q=[successes,r-1], uniform_reference=[sumM,(r-1)^2], complete branch histograms and integer totals; per-curve canonical-stream hashes. No binomial interval, expected retry cost, speedup, exponent, family or novelty claim.

supervisor_boundary.all_json: Strict JSON: reject duplicate keys, NaN/Infinity, YAML-only content. manifest.yaml contains a complete nested strict JSON run, with actual plan/trial/launch/environment/command/clock facts. The unchanged native complete_manifest schema-valid early return preserves its exact bytes. Test the actual helper route before freeze. Fixtures with a format-only plan use fixture_only:true and approved_by:null; this supplies test facts only and grants no scientific authority. Exact launched interpreter argv comes from sys.orig_argv, including flags.
supervisor_boundary.publication: Checker RC0 means structural complete outputs only; scientific_validity remains not_assessed; independent mathematical validation is still required.
supervisor_boundary.source: tools/experiment_execution.py complete_manifest schema-valid early return; no core change or fallback YAML parser

unified_export: export.json passes schemas/experiment-export.v1.json; exact-density member/source seal is nested under backend_record with schema exact-density.export-seal/v1. There is one invocation row, actual file hashes and complete/not_completed flow. Future scientific plan requires exact_density.protocol naming the real frozen protocol.json; its canonical freeze hash is recomputed and checked, and inputs retain both canonical and full-file SHA. Optional trial.parameters.export_arm selects the predeclared export arm only; it never changes the fixed primary predicate. Fixture export protocol fields explicitly name actual unit inputs, never a scientific approval.
